text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
First day of summer training camp. Mr. 
C.B. is interviewed by an UmaTube channel 
called "Weekly Pakatto Channel."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The young man running the channel was also 
an ardent fan of Mr. C.B.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
He explained that a divide had formed 
between the younger and older generations. 
The younger generation claimed Mr. C.B., 
while the older generation claimed the 
"Legend" as the greatest ever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There was no way to measure who was truly 
stronger. Yet, the young man said that one 
naturally wants to believe the Umamusume 
they've followed is the greatest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Mr. C.B. didn't care at all, 
saying she would simply continue running 
however she pleased. —And so, this year's 
summer training camp began.
